subPlotPars.description:
Subplot parameters. If not given, the default subplot parameters rcParams["figure.subplot.*"] are used.
(matplotlib subplotpars)

Python: SubplotParams

tightLayout.description:
If False use subplotpars. If True adjust subplot parameters using tight_layout with default padding. When providing a dict containing the keys pad, w_pad, h_pad, and rect, the default tight_layout paddings will be overridden.
(matplotlib tight_layout)

Python: bool or dict

constrainedLayout.description:
If True use constrained layout to adjust positioning of plot elements. Like tight_layout, but designed to be more flexible. See Constrained Layout Guide for examples. (Note: does not work with subplot() or subplot2grid().) Defaults to rcParams["figure.constrained_layout.use"].
(matplotlib constrained_layout)
